permissions.window.overlay: to draw the now-playing card and its play, skip and volume buttons above your panes

permissions.net:api.spotify.com: to ask Spotify what is playing and to play, pause, skip and change the volume

permissions.page: to play Spotify inside Tilefold, in a hidden page that only makes sound

permissions.script:sdk.scdn.co: to load Spotify's own player in that page
